note: One case over defaults.dmn: the record `c` arrives WITHOUT its `timeout` component, which the source
says is TYPICALLY 30. The expectation is the answer the source gives (30 TIMES 2 = 60), so the harness
reports a mismatch on both engines, and the tests in jl4/tests-cli/CliTest/DmnBpmn.hs read what each
engine printed instead of the verdict.
Measured 2026-10-03 (Camunda 8.7.6, KIE 8.44.0.Final): BOTH read the missing component as null and
BOTH are silent about it. KIE does not treat a missing record component like a missing top-level
input (null-absent.dmn: a model error, the decision SKIPPED); it evaluates the decision and answers
null. A D-TYPICALLY note on a record field says exactly that.

cases.name: c.timeout left out of the record
